The main takeaway from our work is that

the QP-based approach to solving the constrained non-linear model predictive control (NMPC) problem, which is widely used in the literature, is in fact valid for a much larger class of non-linear systems than previously thought, and that this class of systems can be identified in terms of a simple system parameter, namely the input–output linear horzon.

, for systems with a quadratic cost, the QP formulation is not only a good approximation to the non-linear optimal control problem, but it is also the exact solution for the non-linear optimal controller, provided the optimisation is performed over a sufficiently short time horizon.
QP-based NMPC can be applied to a wider range of non-linear systems than was previously thought.
